title: The RAG System That Refuses to Go Stale
excerpt: Last month I built a RAG system that refuses to hallucinate. Then a simpler question broke my own design — what happens when a client has a hundred documents and forty of them change every day? "Clear and rebuild" doesn't survive contact with that. A journal entry about the slower kind of lie.

title: Governance as a Feature: The Retail System That Can't Lie About Itself
excerpt: Three weeks ago I called vibe-coded software a liability. This is the counter-proof — a multi-store retail platform AI wrote most of, built so its permissions, its documentation, and its money can't silently drift from reality. Including an honest account of what's still broken.

title: The Balcony Pattern: Building Deterministic Software With a Non-Deterministic Companion
excerpt: Notes from building Piper — a voice layer that turned into a study of how humans and dumb-but-useful models actually collaborate. The deterministic layer's job is to hold the non-deterministic layer accountable to ground truth.

title: Design Patterns in Dart
excerpt: All 23 Gang of Four patterns in Dart. For each one — what was going wrong, what the pattern fixes, and a minimal, runnable example. The wrong-way snippets are real patterns of pain, not strawmen.

title: On Agile, AI, and the One Engineering Problem That Refuses to Die
excerpt: The problem is whether the humans who can reason in a particular way are producing more humans who can reason the same way — or whether they are stepping into architectural roles, encoding their judgment, and quietly taking the generative structure of that judgment with them.

title: From Vibe Coder to Software Engineer: The Hill You Need to Climb
excerpt: Vibe coding isn't the enemy. Vibe coding "without architecture" is the enemy.

title: The RAG System That Refuses to Hallucinate
excerpt: I built a RAG system and tried to break it. I asked questions with no answers, injected false premises, demanded geography from a story that never named a country. It refused — gracefully, with citations. A journal entry about constraint-aware synthesis.

title: Payment System Architecture for Multi-Module Platforms
excerpt: When multiple booking modules share a platform, payment cannot live inside any one of them. It must be extracted, made generic, and governed by a single contract. Here is how.

title: "Staging Intelligence: A Dramaturgical Framework for Designing Edge-Native Agentic Systems"
excerpt: "Agent systems are better understood as staged plays — with worlds, characters, acts, and controlled improvisation — than as traditional workflows. The Lead's master's thesis."

title: Domain Modeling Is Not Diagramming
excerpt: Most teams confuse domain modeling with drawing boxes and arrows. A domain model is not a diagram — it is an understanding.
